changeSet.comment: Update single document: rename author field value

{ update: 'authors', updates: [ { q: { _id: 'author-002' }, u: { $set: { name: 'Robert C. Martin' } }, upsert: false } ] }

changeSet.author: admin
changeSet.comment: Bulk update: add 'status' field to all books (set to 'active')

runCommand.command: { update: 'books', updates: [ { q: {}, u: { $set: { status: 'active' } }, multi: true } ] }
{ update: 'books', updates: [ { q: {}, u: { $unset: { status: '' } }, multi: true } ] }

changeSet.author: admin
changeSet.comment: Conditional update: mark books with 500+ pages as 'extended' edition

runCommand.command: { update: 'books', updates: [ { q: { pages: { $gte: 500 } }, u: { $set: { edition: 'extended' } }, multi: true } ] }
{ update: 'books', updates: [ { q: { edition: 'extended' }, u: { $unset: { edition: '' } }, multi: true } ] }

changeSet.author: admin
changeSet.comment: Increment update: increase page count by 10 for revised books

runCommand.command: { update: 'books', updates: [ { q: { _id: 'book-001' }, u: { $inc: { pages: 10 } } }, { q: { _id: 'book-002' }, u: { $inc: { pages: 10 } } } ] }
{ update: 'books', updates: [ { q: { _id: 'book-001' }, u: { $inc: { pages: -10 } } }, { q: { _id: 'book-002' }, u: { $inc: { pages: -10 } } } ] }

changeSet.author: admin
changeSet.comment: Rename field: rename 'email' to 'contactEmail' in authors collection

runCommand.command: { update: 'authors', updates: [ { q: {}, u: { $rename: { email: 'contactEmail' } }, multi: true } ] }
{ update: 'authors', updates: [ { q: {}, u: { $rename: { contactEmail: 'email' } }, multi: true } ] }

changeSet.author: admin
changeSet.comment: Array update: add 'tags' array field to books

runCommand.command: { update: 'books', updates: [ { q: { _id: 'book-001' }, u: { $set: { tags: ['java', 'best-practices'] } } }, { q: { _id: 'book-002' }, u: { $set: { tags: ['clean-code', 'refactoring'] } } }, { q: { _id: 'book-003' }, u: { $set: { tags: ['distributed-systems', 'data'] } } } ] }

{ update: 'books', updates: [ { q: { _id: 'book-001' }, u: { $unset: { tags: '' } } }, { q: { _id: 'book-002' }, u: { $unset: { tags: '' } } }, { q: { _id: 'book-003' }, u: { $unset: { tags: '' } } } ] }
